name: GO Transit / Metrolinx Open Data
tagline: Greater Toronto GO Transit schedules and real-time GTFS feeds for developers
description: Metrolinx Open Data provides GTFS schedule and real-time vehicle/trip update feeds for GO Transit and related regional transit services in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area. Developers use static GTFS files and GTFS-Realtime endpoints for trip planning, service alerts, and live vehicle positions.

auth.details: API key required for real-time Open Data endpoints; obtained via Metrolinx Open Data registration. Static GTFS may be downloadable without a key.

use_cases: get next GO train departures for a station
download GO Transit GTFS schedule for trip planning
fetch real-time vehicle positions for GO trains
check service alerts and delays for GO Transit lines
look up stop and route metadata for GTHA regional transit
